{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal orders and converted ones
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
converted_count = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_count / n_loyal

# Print each required number explicitly
print(n_loyal)
print(converted_count)
print(conversion_rate)"}
